class.name: RailVehiclePowerSupply
class.brief_description: The vehicle's low voltage: the battery, the converter and the 24 V / 110 V supply they feed.
class.description: A carriage has one as well as a locomotive - a FIZ describes it by [code]Light:LMaxVoltage[/code] or by the battery and converter keys of [code]Cntrl.[/code]. A vehicle without one (a freight wagon) has no low voltage.

method.name: converter
method.description: Switches the converter ([code]ConverterSwitch()[/code]); the command is sent along the control line to the vehicles that carry one.

method.name: get_battery_enabled
method.description: Whether the battery is switched on ([code]Battery[/code]).

method.name: get_converter_allowed
method.description: Whether the converter's switch is on ([code]ConverterAllow[/code]).

method.name: get_converter_time_to_start
method.description: How long the converter still takes to start [s] ([code]ConverterStartDelayTimer[/code]).

method.name: get_power24_available
method.description: Whether the 24 V circuit is live ([code]Power24vIsAvailable[/code]).

method.name: get_power110_available
method.description: Whether the 110 V circuit is live ([code]Power110vIsAvailable[/code]).

signal.name: power_changed
signal.description: The low voltage came or went
